task_completion.description: Open the human insulin gene sequence file in UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE window shows 'human_insulin_gene.gb' loaded in the Project View or Sequence View.

task_completion.description: Configure and run motif searches for TATA_box, E_box, GC_box, polyA_signal, and CArG_box using the specified patterns and modes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the 'Search in Sequence' dialog or 'Find Pattern' interface with the specified strings (e.g., 'CANNTG', 'CC[AT]{6}GG') and search modes (Exact, IUPAC, or Regexp) being applied.

task_completion.description: Annotate the found motifs using the exact motif names as the annotation name/group.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Sequence View shows color-coded annotations labeled with the motif names (e.g., 'E_box', 'GC_box') on the sequence tracks.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated sequence to the specified GenBank file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export as GenBank' dialog is visible with the output path set to '~/UGENE_Data/results/insulin_motifs_annotated.gb'.

task_completion.description: Create a text report containing sequence details, motif counts, hit positions, and biological interpretation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal view shows 'motif_report.txt' containing the sequence name, length, hit counts for all 5 motifs, start..end positions, and a 2-4 sentence interpretation regarding pancreatic beta cells.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI for sequence analysis and annotation rather than just terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, menus, and dialog boxes being actively used.

integrity.description: The motif counts in the report match the actual search results from the loaded file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The hit counts in the final report correspond to the number of annotations visible in the UGENE sequence track.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing report file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen typing or saving the report content within the environment.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task uses sequence NM_000207.3 (mRNA) by default. Because this is mRNA and not genomic DNA, the TATA_box and CArG_box (promoter elements) will likely have 0 hits. Expected counts for NM_000207.3 are: TATA_box: 0, GC_box: 1, polyA_signal: 1, E_box: 6, and CArG_box: 0. If the agent finds 0 for TATA or CArG, this is biologically correct for the provided file and should not be penalized.
